files.content:
---
import { cn } from '@/utils/cn';
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'astro/types';

export interface Props extends HTMLAttributes<'th'> {
  /** Render a sort button; clicking cycles ascending/descending. */
  sortable?: boolean;
}

const { sortable = false, class: className, ...props } = Astro.props;

const classes = cn(
  'h-12 px-4 text-left align-middle font-medium text-muted-foreground [&:has([role=checkbox])]:pr-0',
  className
);
---

<th class={classes} data-sortable={sortable ? 'true' : undefined} {...props}>
  {
    sortable ? (
      <button
        type="button"
        data-table-sort
        class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md transition-colors hover:text-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring"
      >
        <slot />
        <svg
          data-sort-icon="none"
          class="size-3.5 opacity-50"
          aria-hidden="true"
          xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
          viewBox="0 0 24 24"
          fill="none"
          stroke="currentColor"
          stroke-width="2"
          stroke-linecap="round"
          stroke-linejoin="round"
        >
          <path d="m7 15 5 5 5-5" />
          <path d="m7 9 5-5 5 5" />
        </svg>
        <svg
          data-sort-icon="asc"
          class="hidden size-3.5"
          aria-hidden="true"
          xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
          viewBox="0 0 24 24"
          fill="none"
          stroke="currentColor"
          stroke-width="2"
          stroke-linecap="round"
          stroke-linejoin="round"
        >
          <path d="m5 12 7-7 7 7" />
          <path d="M12 19V5" />
        </svg>
        <svg
          data-sort-icon="desc"
          class="hidden size-3.5"
          aria-hidden="true"
          xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
          viewBox="0 0 24 24"
          fill="none"
          stroke="currentColor"
          stroke-width="2"
          stroke-linecap="round"
          stroke-linejoin="round"
        >
          <path d="M12 5v14" />
          <path d="m19 12-7 7-7-7" />
        </svg>
      </button>
    ) : (
      <slot />
    )
  }
</th>
